name: Block Editor for Products
author: Paulo Jacomelli

sections.description:
Block Editor for Products enables the WordPress block editor for the “product” post type.

Some themes or plugins may disable the block editor for products by default. This plugin safely re-enables it, allowing you to enjoy the power and flexibility of block-based editing — without adding settings or overhead.

✅ Features
– Enables the block editor for the “product” post type
– Compatible with WordPress core and block-based themes
– Lightweight (no settings, no database writes)

🧩 No configuration required.
Just install and activate — the block editor becomes available for products automatically.

Localization

This plugin is fully translatable and ships with a Brazilian Portuguese translation file (pt_BR).

License

This plugin is free software, licensed under the GNU General Public License v2 or later.
You can redistribute it and/or modify it under the same license terms.

Author

Developed and maintained by Paulo Jacomelli
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/block-editor-for-products directory, or install via the WordPress Plugin Installer.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Edit or create a product — the block editor will now be available.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin add any new settings or database tables?

No. It’s a single-function plugin that only enables the block editor for products.

Is any specific plugin required?

Not strictly. If a plugin disables the block editor, it may override this plugin.

Can I uninstall it safely?

Yes. Deactivating or deleting the plugin restores the default WordPress behavior.
